preamble: These findings were tested for the PRIMARY league and are shown here for reference only -- see each finding's result field. Per ADR-041, league-specific results are not assumed to generalize.

findings.claim_tested: Spike-week ability is a persistent player trait (test-registry #38)
findings.method: For every player-season 1999-2024, measured how often a player cleared the 100 / 150 / 200 yard bonus thresholds, subtracted how often his yardage alone implies he should have, and correlated that leftover across consecutive seasons. 36 correlations, confidence intervals bootstrapped by resampling players.
findings.plain_language_summary: This was tested for the primary league under its own scoring rules and roster shape, not for 'YAHOO-default, 8 teams, full scoring'. Per ADR-041, results like this one are league-specific and are not assumed to generalize -- re-running the underlying analysis for this league has not been done.
